description: Implement complete trading strategy with all components: (1) Data loading and preprocessing from CSV/API with OHLCV validation, (2) Indicator calculation for 30-period Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and 70-period EMA, (3) Entry conditions: Open long position when 30 EMA crosses above 70 EMA; Open short position when 30 EMA crosses below 70 EMA, (4) Exit conditions: Set stop loss at 15 pips from entry price and take profit at 70 pips from entry price, (5) Complete backtest runner using an adapter-driven architecture (e.g., SimBroker). Include explicit loop termination conditions (e.g., max_iterations), robust error handling, and comprehensive logging. Ensure the strategy is production-ready and fully testable.
